identity.title: Live-canary SIWC phase-bound OAuth caller integration
identity.objective: Integrate the merged D005 phase-bound OAuth operator records into the existing live-canary caller using synthetic/offline tests only; keep live, product network, credentials and economic actions disabled.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert only ten declared paths on the feature branch. No credential, source-retirement, canary ledger, host, runtime/profile or production rollback is part of this software WP.

api_matrix.reason: Wire existing independent native phase admission into the existing dormant canary caller. Only the caller is writable; OAuth transport remains unchanged.

items.before: Original case has no phase-record path fields.
items.after: Add two optional absolute paths; old check and synthetic cases remain valid.
items.compatibility_requirement: No credential bytes or selected account identity in case; new fields cannot be silently inferred.

items.before: One real transport has no operator record and is reused for preflight/dispatch.
items.after: Construct distinct real transports, separately bound to preflight-only and dispatch operator records.
items.compatibility_requirement: Keep native transport API and R005 dispatch lease; no operator-path mutation, fallback or second send.

items.before: Stage A -> witnessed OAuth -> native handoff -> attended confirmation -> one canary.
items.after: Same sequence with phase-bound caller; failure remains zero economic and consumed journal semantics hold.
items.compatibility_requirement: Existing TTY/Stage A/geoblock/account/host/risk/order and fake-injection boundaries untouched.

items.before: Merged D005 six-operation child-enforced admission; no-record production caller fails closed.
items.after: Unchanged; caller supplies matching distinct records per native phase.

semantic_fields.reason: Five bounded rules matched verbatim to the prompt; no new cryptographic identity is introduced.

items.required_rule: Extend the existing closed live-canary case schema with two optional absolute local paths for separate preflight-only and dispatch operator records. Check remains non-economic and does not open either record; existing offline fixture cases and injected seam tests remain valid. A production native OAuth attempt requires both distinct nonempty paths before it constructs any transport or accesses credentials, and missing/same/invalid paths fail closed without leaking local paths or record content. Do not put credentials, selected client/subject, token values, operator-record JSON, or source/destination host identifiers in the case or public receipt.

items.expected_result: Case schema remains backward compatible; absent/duplicate/invalid production paths refuse before transport or credential IO, preserving legacy missing-path refusal; native child rejects cross-wired records without leaks.

Actual native mock children prove distinct preflight-only/dispatch admissions with UNVERIFIED eligibility/origin; separate intercepted caller seams exercise witnessed gates with synthetic private files and no provider network.
Witness freshness/authority and one journal/one attempt remain; wrong or denied phase leads zero dispatch/order.
Existing fake/recorded tests and Stage A/TTY/no-fallback behavior unchanged; D005 source and API untouched.
No records/tokens/client/subject/local paths reach receipts; synthetic outcomes never assert live entitlement.
